notes: Virginia has TWO distinct statewide honor choir tracks. (1) All-Virginia Chorus, administered by VCDA (the Virginia Choral Directors Association, a VMEA affiliate), fed by all-district choir auditions run by each of VCDA's numbered districts using district-specific procedures; the All-Virginia Band, Chorus and Orchestra event is April 22-24, 2027 at the Greater Richmond Convention Center. (2) The VMEA Senior Honors Choir, auditioned online through SNAP Audition and performing at the VMEA Conference, November 19-21, 2026 in Richmond, open only to 12th graders. VCDA publishes audition format as 'TBD by each District' and audition date only as 'February' with no specific 2027 day; district-level dates and fees live in per-district PDF procedure manuals that were not individually retrieved. No fee amounts are published on VCDA's or VMEA's public pages.

organization.name: Virginia Music Educators Association
organization.description: VMEA is Virginia's NAfME state affiliate. Its choral affiliate, the Virginia Choral Directors Association (VCDA), administers the All-Virginia Chorus and the district all-district choir auditions that feed it; VMEA itself runs the Senior Honors Choir at its annual conference.

programs.name: All-Virginia Chorus
programs.description: The All-Virginia Chorus, administered by VCDA, brings together Virginia's top high school vocalists. It performs alongside the All-Virginia Band and Orchestra. Students qualify through all-district auditions; the audition format is set by each VCDA district, using the statewide All-Virginia audition selection from VCDA's yearly rotation plus sight reading.

dates.title: All-Virginia Chorus auditions
dates.description: VCDA lists the audition date only as 'February' with no specific day published for 2027; the audition format is TBD by each district.

dates.title: 2027 All-Virginia Band, Chorus and Orchestra
dates.description: Greater Richmond Convention Center, 403 N. 3rd Street, Richmond, VA 23219.

requirements.title: Audition format set by each district
requirements.description: VCDA publishes the All-Virginia audition format as 'TBD by each District'. Each numbered VCDA district posts its own all-district audition procedures PDF on the District Procedures page.

requirements.title: Statewide audition repertoire on a yearly rotation
requirements.description: Auditions use the All-Virginia audition songs on VCDA's published yearly rotation. VCDA posts part-specific sheet music PDFs and part-predominant audio practice files for the current selection, organized by voice pairing (S1/T1, S2/T2, A1/B1, A2/B2).

requirements.title: Sight reading component
requirements.description: VCDA publishes sight-reading examples from previous years and sight-reading starter recordings for audition preparation.

repertoire.title: Where'er You Walk
repertoire.notes: Listed by VCDA as the All-Virginia Chorus audition selection for the 2026-2027 rotation year. Part-specific PDFs and audio files are posted by voice pairing with the transposition indicated per pairing (S2/T2 in A-flat, S1/T1 in B-flat, A1/B1 in F, A2/B2 in E-flat). VCDA does not credit a composer on this page.

programs.name: VMEA Senior Honor Choir
programs.description: VMEA's Senior Honor Choir performs during the annual VMEA Conference in Richmond. Auditions are hosted online through SNAP Audition. The 2026 conductor is Deanna Joseph of Georgia State University.

dates.title: 2026 VMEA Senior Honor Choir
dates.description: Held during the 2026 VMEA Conference in Richmond.

requirements.title: 12th grade students in a VMEA member's choral ensemble
requirements.description: All 12th grade students enrolled in a VMEA member's school choral ensemble are eligible to audition.

requirements.title: Online audition via SNAP Audition
requirements.description: SNAP Audition is used to host online auditions. Students record their voice part along with the other voice parts and accompaniment to submit on SNAP, and complete one sight-reading example. Practice and performance tracks are posted by VMEA.

requirements.title: One sight-reading example
requirements.description: Students complete one sight-reading example as part of the SNAP submission.

repertoire.title: Swifter Than Flame
repertoire.notes: Audition excerpt is measure 54 to the end. The selection is drawn from the Honor Choir performance repertoire.
